dinkum-4.authenticity: Sounds like Australian sports copy: "has called time on his baseball career", "stuck with them for his first nine seasons".
dinkum-4.register: A light level-2 touch: a handful of terms ("called time", "crook shoulder", "hung up the glove", "All up") over plain sports reporting. No swearing.
dinkum-4.tone: Stays a straight sports news brief: "picking up All-Star selections in 2014 and 2016".
